full_en: We have also established a specific version of a private jet by-the-seat booking tool for the Las Vegas Golden Knights professional ice hockey team and Great Western Air, LLC (DBA Cirrus Aviation Services, LLC) (“Cirrus”) via 380 Software LLC. 380 Software LLC is a by-the-seat charter joint venture between us and Cirrus. Our strategy historically has involved expanding our fleet of aircraft with larger aircraft capable of traveling longer distances, developing a national jet card program based on third party aircraft, further enhancing the AI functionality of CharterGPT, and expanding upon our B2B software offerings. Our strategy currently involves further enhancing the AI functionality of Ava, our agentic AI model, and CharterGPT, and expanding upon Reroute AI and DynoFlight.
